name: The Frozenfar
title: The Frozenfar: The Land of Ten-Towns
description: The Frozenfar is the remote, frigid region north of the Spine of the World, dominated by the tundra of Icewind Dale.
wiki: The Frozenfar is most famous for Icewind Dale and its Ten-Towns. It is a land of white dragons, frost giants, and survival at the edge of the world. The only connection to the south is through the treacherous mountain passes.

popup.title: Bryn Shander
popup.description: The largest and only walled town of the Ten-Towns.

popup.title: Kuldahar
popup.description: A haven built around a magical great oak that radiates warmth.

popup.title: Spine of the World
popup.description: The massive mountain range that separates the Frozenfar from the rest of the North.
